scope: Safe, bounded OpenAI-compatible (MJ-REQ-108.A01), OpenAI (MJ-REQ-108.A02), and loopback-only Local Endpoint (MJ-REQ-108.A05) AI providers with telemetry integration, SSRF defense, and AIProviderSettings UI component.

acceptance.openai_compatible: PASS; OpenAICompatibleProvider supports /chat/completions, structured output (json_object), telemetry recording, and safe cancellation.
acceptance.openai_provider: PASS; OpenAIProvider defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1 with Bearer token authentication from environment.
acceptance.local_endpoint_provider: PASS; LocalEndpointProvider strictly enforces loopback IP addresses (127.0.0.1, [::1]) to prevent SSRF while enabling local model servers (LM Studio, LocalAI, vLLM).
acceptance.provider_factory: PASS; create_provider maps 'disabled', 'ollama', 'openai', 'openai-compatible', 'local' cleanly and safely rejects unsupported providers.
acceptance.frontend_settings: PASS; AIProviderSettings renders provider cards with status indicators, capability badges, model identifiers, concurrency slots, and masked API keys.
acceptance.safety: PASS; external submission OFF asserted; no live inference or paid API execution during automated tests.

checks.target: Unit and contract tests for OpenAICompatibleProvider, OpenAIProvider, and LocalEndpointProvider
AI task router and structured output validation tests
TypeScript check and Vite production client build
